title: ObjectGenome bounded validation work
objective: Close the demonstrated ObjectGenome cardinality/work-bound gaps so oversized immutable recipe collections and mutable ObjectState snapshots reject at project-owned bounded preflight fences before nested graph/identity/ownership or state-map traversal, without changing ObjectGenome identity/schema semantics or depending on Studio.
acceptance: introduce explicit named project-owned maximum cardinalities for immutable v1 recipe collections at least components, each component.supportKeys, mechanisms, and affordances; choose limits from canonical fixture/resource-budget audit rather than arbitrary mining-time numbers

oversized immutable recipe collections reject at bounded preflight points before validatePlainGenomeTables/validateGenomeShape nested traversal, support-graph/reachability work, recipe fingerprinting, or ownership cloning can consume work proportional to arbitrarily large caller input
top-level ObjectState validation rejects once observed entries exceed the fixed v1 STATE_FIELDS cardinality instead of scanning an arbitrarily wider table

componentWear, componentDamage, and detachedComponents reject once observed entries exceed the exact genome component count; mechanismPosition rejects once observed entries exceed the exact genome mechanism count
over-cardinality rejection uses deterministic field-level diagnostics that do not depend on pairs traversal order or stringify hostile keys
within-bound recipes/snapshots preserve existing dense-shape, missing-key, unknown-key, value-range, kind-specific mechanism, metatable, aliasing, support-graph, and exact genomeId behavior
ObjectGenome/ObjectState schema versions, stable identity inputs, recipe fingerprint semantics, and previously valid under-cap fixture outputs remain unchanged

add deterministic regressions proving exact-cap immutable recipe collections remain accepted, cap+1 components/supportKeys/mechanisms/affordances fail at the early cardinality fence, exact-cardinality valid snapshots remain accepted, and oversized plain state maps/top-level state fail without claiming an unmeasured timing result
audit validate/inspect, recipeFingerprint, and ObjectGenomeOwnership construction/clone public paths so valid canonical work is bounded by the new recipe limits before downstream traversal
no Roblox Studio or engine-evidence claim
notes: Capacity-mined from retained ObjectGenome generation-8 PR #395 after confirming its independent source/test approval and existing identity/key/aliasing/deterministic-diagnostic/decoder-shape closure. The original finding showed inspectState traverses every supplied top-level and mutable-map key even though v1 exact-snapshot semantics provide natural maximum cardinalities. Follow-up mining found the immutable recipe has the same bounded-work class: validateDenseArray has no maxCount, and inspect() traverses components/mechanisms/affordances before dense validation while support reachability can make componentCount passes. Fold both defects into this one proposed leaf to avoid overlapping ObjectGenome source/test WIP. Dependency prevents overlap with retained #395 while live pr-ownership recovery is blocked.
